title: Keep reusable business assets under durable control
text: Huber’s doctrine distinguishes company context and tools from rented model capability and commodity infrastructure. This is a useful procurement question: which assets would be required to reproduce the service or improve it with a different supplier?
qualification: Practitioner heuristic. It does not mean that every internal application should be custom-built or that provider contracts are automatically sufficient.
